info.name: PCH - Unified Master and Onboarding APIs
info.description: Merged from the two supplied Downloads collections on 2026-09-16. All requests, examples, scripts, and folder structures are preserved under their source groups. Shared accessToken, merchantId and storeId variables allow using onboarding login/allocated IDs with master requests. Source-specific collection scripts run only in their source group. To avoid conflicting URL conventions, master baseUrl retains its API-prefixed URL; onboardingBaseUrl is the service origin with no /api/v1 suffix. masterBaseUrl remains unchanged. onboardingPlanCode retains STARTER while master planCode retains BASIC_MONTHLY. Set appropriate existing plan codes and account credentials before sending requests. Alternate create requests are examples, not a sequential runner workflow.

item.name: 01 - Master, Mappings and Employee APIs
item.description:
PCH master APIs for store types, features, role templates and plans. New requests use masterBaseUrl (default http://localhost:3003/api/v1). Create saves roleTemplateId/planId automatically. Existing saved response examples are preserved. Use unique codes for repeated creates. Plans use public.plans, separate from subscription plans.

Added Relationship APIs: 36 requests covering store-type features/role templates, plan entitlements, subscription stores and subscription/store entitlement overrides. Uses existing collection variables and OWNER bearer authentication.
Subscriptions now use the commercial plans.id relationship and contract dates, counts, currency and history.

Postman checks: collection scripts validate required variables, HTTP status, success, entity IDs, list counts and subscription contract fields. Successful Create responses save storeTypeId, featureId, roleTemplateId, planId and subscriptionId as collection variables. Supply masterBaseUrl, accessToken and existing merchantId/storeId where needed. Remove environment overrides for auto-saved IDs. Missing-variable diagnostics appear in Test Results and the Postman Console; requests are not blocked. Run Create requests before dependent mappings. Delete requests perform real deletion: select requests intentionally, and remove dependent mappings before deleting masters. Existing duplicate codes can return 409; use unused sample codes for fresh creates.

Added section 5: 34 additional requests for employee/permission PATCH, role CRUD, employee store assignments, employee store roles, role template permissions, role permissions and effective-access checks. Employee/role/permission creates save their IDs automatically. Employee store creation saves employeeStoreId. All administration requests require an active OWNER session. Set existing parent IDs; create the employee, role and permission before assigning mappings. An allowed role permission never bypasses feature entitlement.

item.name: 05 - Employee, Role and Permission Model
item.description: Section 5: OWNER bearer session required. Roles apply to employee-store assignments. Create requests save roleId and employeeStoreId. Use existing merchantId, storeId and featureId. Each effective-access decision requires both an entitled feature and a role permission. DELETE removes relationship mappings; prefer status INACTIVE to retain assignment history.

exec: // PCH: show missing inputs before sending a request.
const missing = required.filter(key => { const value = pm.variables.get(key); return value === undefined || value === null || String(value).trim() === ''; });
if (missing.length) console.error('Set these Postman variables before sending: ' + missing.join(', '));
// Diagnostics only: this script does not skip requests or run other APIs.
// PCH: shared checks for all master and relationship APIs.
pm.test('Required request variables are populated', () => pm.expect(missing, 'Missing: ' + missing.join(', ')).to.be.empty);
pm.test('Response is valid JSON', () => { data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.be.an('object'); });

const entities = {storeType:'storeTypeId', feature:'featureId', roleTemplate:'roleTemplateId', plan:'planId', subscription:'subscriptionId', employee:'employeeId', role:'roleId', permission:'permissionId'};
// Save only created master entities. Mapping item.id is never a feature/plan ID.
if (pm.environment.has(variable)) console.warn(variable + ' also exists in the environment; remove its override to use the new collection ID.');
subscriptions.forEach((subscription,index) => pm.test('Subscription ' + (index+1) + ' contains the contract fields', () => fields.forEach(field => pm.expect(subscription).to.have.property(field))));

item.name: 02 - Merchant and Store Onboarding APIs
item.description: Updated 2026-09-16. New two-stage onboarding and existing store APIs. Run login, inspect active masters, allocate IDs, create merchant, then add stores. Choose an existing active commercial plan/store-type code. Requests are examples to run individually: alternate create-store routes must not all be run with the same ID. No payment or access provisioning: device/role/feature selections are configuration drafts. New onboarding subscriptions/stores remain PENDING. Omitted stores are preserved. Requires latest merchant-service code and additive migration 08_store_onboarding_setup.sql (also applied on service startup).
